name: Sendou Erika
source:
Erika is also a fifth-year student, as well as the student council vice-president. She is a vampire. She is strong in literature classes and martial arts, and is very attractive, making her popular in her school. She has an inquisitive personality, and likes to do things directly. Once she has her mind set on something, she becomes very pushy, and will take her time making plans to make sure she gets her way. Her older brother [url=/c1198]Iori[/url] is the student council president.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Arterial]Wikipedia[/url].]
